lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦後の農政改革史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on postwar agricultural policy reform, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, confirming—not interrogating. Warm interest. A teacher recognizing a student's work with genuine curiosity.

lines.en: Yes, I wrote mine on Taiwan's postwar political history under the Kuomintang.
lines.style: Earnest and precise. Slight formality in the register—respectful toward the teacher. Clear articulation, steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher

lines.speaker: ren_uni

lines.style: Steady and direct. Same earnest register. Slightly quicker than the teacher's pace—eager to clarify without rushing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher

lines.speaker: ren_uni
